baseline_scope: 51 published426 width>1 profiles inventoried, not 51 newly qualified profiles. Primary-source/runtime reconstruction covered26 groups/45 profiles. Four groups/six profiles remain source-unavailable with unchanged historical bytecode evidence. MUSD/OLY/NXT excluded.
callable_setter: TaggerToken public onlyOwner setRoleAdmin accepts arbitrary bytes32 role. Preserve real admin writes with the exact-depth rule; plain-root narrowing alone is insufficient.
enumerable_sets: Eight profiles use EnumerableSet at the configured root. Their valid index mapping is anchored at outer+1 and array data at keccak(outer), not at outer. The proposed boolean rule does not cover them. They need a separate typed set/array rule with validated outer preimage, actual member offsets and array length/index treatment. The344checks include80 enumerable controls: correct index/array words reject and fabricated offset-zero mapping words accept under current config. This demonstrates guard limitations, not an observed historical balance error.
initialization_and_creation: SecuritiesToken17, DeepTokenOFT1 and BTRToken1 only call the setter for finite known roles during initialization. Exact precomputed admin slots plus plain membership roots can be a config-only alternative; this phase did not calculate/promote those slots or assert initialized-state locks. BASToken has a constructor-only PAUSER_ROLE admin write; postdeployment narrowing differs from creation qualification.

minimal_future_rule_proposal.field_name: other_mapping_word_paths (illustrative; not a supported config field)
matching_semantics: Walk exactly the declared number of verified64-byte keccak preimages from the terminal key minus its allowed field offset; require the final base to equal the configured root. Do not accept arbitrary additional ancestors or apply terminal width at every depth.
Validate address/uint32 key words against their canonical ABI width. A bytes32 role key is unrestricted. All hashes must match their supplied preimages.
Keep existing persistence/revert handling, final-write semantics, runtime/proxy guards and the single RPC-free map. No protobuf or cache change is required for this recognition rule.
Only attach the outer-admin rule to a reviewed callable/initialization field; it must not become a broad two-word rule for nested membership leaves.

Do not globally reinterpret existing other_mapping_words: terminal records with genuine multiword values may rely on current nested mapping ancestry. Migrate only individually reviewed profiles after full gates.

role_data_rules.purpose: outer admin field, only when reachable and reviewed
